machine: Apple M1 Max, 32 GB unified memory

algorithm.note: The derivative buffer is allocated at full size only when TaylorSeer is selected. Ordinary Cache-DiT retains its original kernels and cap.

taylor_same_cap_control.interpretation: At equal cache decisions, first-order prediction reduces trajectory error substantially; the predictor itself is useful.

taylor_selected_cap.interpretation: This meets the predeclared numerical gate: two fewer full passes at a final latent error close to ordinary Cache-DiT.

lower_threshold_control.interpretation: The lower threshold improves error but does not create a speed advantage over the existing 0.24 policy.

rejected_cap.reason: The extra skipped pass caused a clear numerical regression.

case.prompt: A vintage travel poster for CASABLANCA reading 'MEET ME AT SUNSET', bold geometric lettering.

ordinary_cache_dit.visual: Coherent poster; CASABLANCA, MEET ME AT, and SUNSET are legible.

taylorseer.visual: Coherent poster, but CASABLANCA becomes CASABLANCCA while the remaining requested text stays legible.

controlled_1024_visual.timing_caveat: The two runs were sequential, and full steps in the later ordinary run were slower. The measured 46.747-second end-to-end gap therefore cannot be attributed entirely to the two avoided full passes; cache count is the reproducible structural result.
controlled_1024_visual.quality_decision: The cap-4 policy fails this exact-text visual A/B. Keep TaylorSeer explicit and off by default; do not replace ordinary Cache-DiT.

phase_status: F8 implementation and calibration complete; experimental capability retained, production policy rejected for now
